; NYT Crossword Quick Settings action for firmware 3.28 only.
; Requires qt-resource-rebuilder, qt-command-executor, and the NYT runtime.

SLOT nytQuickDownload
    INSERT {
        ~&10845406345867313529&~ {
            ~&5972374&~: nytQuickDownloadToggle
            visible: nytToday.ready && nytToday.missing && !nytToday.running
            ~&8399601734642709923&~: "qrc:/ark/icons/download"
            ~&233726547792244&~: nytToday.ready && nytToday.missing && !nytToday.running
            ~&7713561545874130&~: nytToday.running

            Rectangle {
                anchors.centerIn: parent
                width: parent.width * 0.72
                height: width
                radius: width / 2
                color: nytToday.running ? "black" : "white"
                Text {
                    anchors.centerIn: parent
                    text: "NYT"
                    color: nytToday.running ? "white" : "black"
                    font.bold: true
                    font.pixelSize: parent.height * 0.28
                }
            }

            AsyncCommandExecutor {
                ~&5972374&~: nytTodayExecutor
                command: "sh"
                arguments: ["/home/root/xovi-nytcrossword/scripts/nytcrossword-run.sh", "today-status"]
                onStdOutAvailable: function(chunk) { nytToday.stdout += chunk; }
                onRunningChanged: {
                    if (!running && nytToday.launched) nytToday.finish();
                }
            }

            ~&7712130752583461&~ {
                ~&5972374&~: nytToday
                property bool launched: false
                property bool running: false
                property bool ready: false
                property bool missing: false
                property string action: ""
                property string stdout: ""

                function notify(message) {
                    ~&233724020023100&~.~&197092075&~(message);
                }
                function run(kind) {
                    if (running) return;
                    ready = false;
                    stdout = "";
                    action = kind;
                    launched = true;
                    running = true;
                    nytTodayExecutor.arguments = [
                        "/home/root/xovi-nytcrossword/scripts/nytcrossword-run.sh", kind
                    ];
                    if (!nytTodayExecutor.startCommand(kind === "download-today" ? 180000 : 30000)) {
                        launched = false;
                        running = false;
                        notify("NYT: could not start " + kind);
                    }
                }
                function start() {
                    if (!ready || !missing || running) return;
                    notify("NYT: downloading today's crossword");
                    run("download-today");
                }
                function finish() {
                    launched = false;
                    running = false;
                    var result;
                    try { result = JSON.parse(stdout); }
                    catch (error) {
                        notify("NYT: invalid backend response");
                        return;
                    }
                    if (nytTodayExecutor.exitCode !== 0 || !result.ok) {
                        notify("NYT: " + (result.message || result.error || "command failed"));
                        return;
                    }
                    if (action === "download-today") {
                        notify(result.count ? "NYT: today's crossword imported" : "NYT: already present");
                        run("today-status");
                    } else {
                        missing = result.missing_count > 0;
                        ready = true;
                    }
                }
            }

            Timer {
                interval: 15000
                repeat: true
                running: nytQuickDownloadToggle.parent.visible
                triggeredOnStart: true
                onTriggered: {
                    if (!nytToday.running) nytToday.run("today-status");
                }
            }
            ~&254542236275632405&~: nytToday.start()
        }
    }
END SLOT

AFFECT [[11542018640809782132]]
    IMPORT net.asivery.CommandExecutor [[180922.180921]]
    TRAVERSE ?#[[6504254477]]
        LOCATE AFTER [[7712155293725601]]
        INSERT SLOT nytQuickDownload
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

AFFECT [[10936356414964521612]]
    IMPORT net.asivery.CommandExecutor [[180922.180921]]
    TRAVERSE ?#[[6504254477]]
        LOCATE AFTER [[7712155293725601]]
        INSERT SLOT nytQuickDownload
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
